worldcombat.skill.naturepower.summary: Calls up the ground it stands on into a ground-hugging ley line that races to the target: plants snare and paralyse, water shoves, underground fire burns, earth shatters armour and pushes back, and any other surface is a plain impact; changing the ground changes what the move does.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.use.0: Let the ground choose the type
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.descriptio: Races to the target as a ground-hugging ley line for %1$s damage; its type follows the ground under the caster (grass to Grass, water to Water, fire to Fire, stone to Rock, otherwise Normal).
The ley line reaches %1$s; plant snare and underground fire land with a %2$s chance, water shoves furthest, and shattering earth also lowers the target's Defence by one stage.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.stance.cha: Charged ley line: the wind-up stretches to %1$s for x1.25 power and +2 blocks of reach, good for heavy hits at range.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.stance.qui: Quick call: a very short wind-up and shorter cooldown for close fighting, with base power and reach.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.timing: A targeted surge move; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.preference: On: about 6 more ticks of wind-up and 4 more ticks of cooldown for x1.25 power and +2 blocks of reach. Off: a very short wind-up and shorter cooldown at base power and reach. Each side has its own situations.
Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion also leaves its post to cast; when off it stays put.
